summary: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. filed an 8-K regarding an at-the-market offering agreement with TD Cowen, effective May 22, 2026. The Company may sell up to $250,000,000 of common stock through TD Cowen as agent, with a 3.0% commission. No shares are guaranteed to be issued; the program is opportunistic. No board recommendation or advisor is named beyond TD Cowen. The filing is a routine capital-raising agreement, not a special situation like an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The at-the-market facility provides liquidity flexibility; the risk-arb angle is nil.
